title: Beyond Overlap: Hierarchical Graph Abstraction for Out-of-Core Vector Search
abstract: arXiv:2512.22838v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: At billion scale, approximate nearest neighbor search (ANNS) often becomes an out-of-core problem: the full vector collection and index structures exceed memory capacity, making query performance dominated by SSD accesses and DRAM-SSD data movement. Existing systems struggle to strike a balance between accuracy and efficiency: physical-overlap methods replicate vectors or index entries across partitions, enlarging the SSD-resident index and incurring extra I/O; quantization-based methods reduce memory usage, but their approximate distances are less reliable and often require costly raw-vector reranking from SSD to preserve recall.   We present GANNS (Graph-Abstraction ANNS), a hierarchical out-of-core ANNS engine that improves accuracy and I/O efficiency simultaneously. translated_title: 超越重叠：面向核外向量搜索的层次图抽象
translated_abstract: arXiv:2512.22838v3 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：在十亿规模下，近似最近邻搜索（ANNS）往往成为一个核外问题：完整的向量集合和索引结构超出了内存容量，使得查询性能主要受限于SSD访问以及DRAM与SSD之间的数据传输。现有系统难以在准确性与效率之间取得平衡：物理重叠方法将向量或索引条目复制到多个分区中，扩大了驻留在SSD上的索引规模并产生额外的I/O开销；而基于量化的方法虽然减少了内存占用，但其近似距离的可靠性较低，通常需要从SSD进行代价高昂的原始向量重排序以维持召回率。我们提出了GANNS（Graph-Abstraction ANNS，图抽象ANNS），一个层次化的核外ANNS引擎，能够同时提升准确性和I/O效率。GANNS将每个簇存储为SSD上互不相交的分区，并配备尺度感知的索引，同时通过一个驻留在内存中的图抽象在发生SSD访问之前提供逻辑重叠。
tldr: GANNS是一种层次化的核外近似最近邻搜索引擎，通过将各簇存储为SSD上互不相交的分区并利用内存中的图抽象在SSD访问前提供逻辑重叠，从而同时提升搜索准确性与I/O效率。
